description: Join search demand (Search Console impressions, clicks, position) with outcomes (GA4 sessions, key events, revenue) per page over the last 28 days, classified into action buckets: CONVERSION_MISMATCH (traffic converts nothing — rewrite for intent), CTR_FIX (demand but weak titles), SCALE_WINNER (converts from page 2 — push it), STRIKING_DISTANCE (position 11-20), DEAD (no demand, no visits). Each row carries a recommendation. Works with Search Console alone; connecting GA4 unlocks the conversion buckets.
